title: Increasing Tangential Gain
statement: Increasing the tangential gain will reduce the robot's tendency to veer off course, thereby reducing the likelihood of collisions.
mechanism: The tangential gain controls how strongly the robot responds to lateral forces, which can help in maintaining a straight path.
